task.title: Modifying the normal weekly hours (NWH) when the effective week of the modification is equal to the Start date on the Project tab

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Project Data — Worksharing (M171) transaction and modify the NWH as follows:

ul.li: Weekly hours: Enter the new NWH. Include a 0 or a 5 at the end to indicate the hour or half hour. Do not include the decimal (e.g. 40 NWH are entered as 400 and 37.5 NWH are entered as 375).

step.cmd: Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Message: Select 55 - Change to Worksharing/Job Creation .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Work item: Select 93 - Manual Pay System .
Work type: Select 30 - New information on a manual pay claim .
Remarks line 1: Type “WS — change in NWH from w/c [XXXX].”
Remarks line 2: Type “Change the NWH of the current WS period to [XX].”
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Message: Select 55 - Change to Worksharing/Job Creation .

step.cmd: Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Message: Select 55 - Change to Worksharing/Job Creation .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06 ) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Work item: Select 92 - Purge and Recreate .
Remarks line 1: Type “WS — change in NWH from w/c [XXXX] to [XXXX].”
Remarks line 2: Type “Change the NWH of the previous WS period to [XX].”
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Message: Select 55 - Change to Worksharing/Job Creation .
